name: word_count
description: Count the characters, words and lines of a text and return the three counts as an object. Pure and stateless: the text is not stored or sent anywhere; no auth beyond the group's key. Words are whitespace-separated runs; lines are newline-separated (a trailing newline does not add a line); characters are Unicode code points including whitespace. Use it when a model needs an exact count rather than an estimate; it does not tokenise or detect language.

text.description: the text to count; may be empty, which yields zeros

lines.description: newline-separated lines; 0 for an empty text
